comment: Public sources of the NOvA cell references. fetch.sh downloads each file and checks its sha256; extract.py reads the figures named here. Cite the source with any use of the extracted points.

testbeam.cite: NOvA Collaboration (S. Abubakar et al.), The NOvA Test Beam program, arXiv:2609.10804v2, FERMILAB-PUB-26-0647-PPD

niner.cite: E. Niner, PhD thesis, Indiana University (2015), FERMILAB-THESIS (public on INSPIRE)

simchain.cite: A. Aurisano et al., The NOvA simulation chain, J. Phys. Conf. Ser. 664 (2015) 072002
